readme.html:
English | 日本語 | 简体中文

Argent is an MCP server, CLI and agent skills that let AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and others) control iOS simulators, Android emulators and devices, TVs (Apple TV, Android TV, Fire TV), Electron/Chromium apps and native Mac apps. Tap a button, profile a screen, reproduce a bug - without leaving the CLI.

npx @swmansion/argent@latest init  # pnpm: pnpm dlx @swmansion/argent@latest init

What it does

  • Interact - tap, swipe, gesture, type, hardware buttons; D-pad on TV; mouse and keyboard on desktop.
  • E2E - record a path once as an e2e test, replay it deterministically as a repro or smoke test.
  • Visual regression - diff a baseline against a live capture, OCR- and font-aware.
  • Profiling - Hermes, React DevTools, Xcode Instruments, Perfetto: renders, CPU hotspots, hangs.
  • Debugging - logs, network (XMLHttpRequest incl. axios, fetch incl. Expo's, and native), JS evaluation, native and React trees.
  • React Native - build, launch and iterate, no extra setup.

Ask your assistant "What can Argent do?" to list every tool.

Documentation

Privacy

Telemetry is opt-out: argent telemetry disable. See the Privacy Notice.

skills.name: argent-android-emulator-setup
skills.description: Boot an Android emulator and find its serial with Argent. Use when no Android emulator is running yet or you need to pick and boot one.

skills.name: argent-create-e2e
skills.description: Create, record, edit, replay, or repair reusable Argent e2e test YAML files. Use when the user asks to record, replay, or run an e2e test or repeatable path, set up profiling/A-B comparison, or before repeating 3+ interactions. For one-off UI checks, writing QA regression tests, or screen video, use

skills.name: argent-device-interact
skills.description: Drive iOS, Android, or Chromium apps with Argent MCP tools. Use when tapping, swiping, typing, launching apps, waiting for UI, or taking screenshots (not for TV targets).

skills.name: argent-ios-device-interact
skills.description: Drive a physical iPhone with Argent. Use when targeting a physical iPhone (list-devices kind "device") and ONLY then, never a simulator. For setup/signing, use `argent-ios-device-setup`.

skills.name: argent-ios-device-setup
skills.description: Set up a physical iPhone over USB or CoreDevice tunnel for Argent. Use when a physical iPhone is involved (kind "device") and ONLY then; never for a simulator.

skills.name: argent-ios-simulator-setup
skills.description: Boot an iOS simulator and find its UDID with Argent. Use when no simulator is booted yet or you need to pick and boot one.

skills.name: argent-lens
skills.description: Propose visual design variants for on-screen elements so the user can pick in Argent Lens. Use when presenting UI design alternatives or A/B choices.

skills.name: argent-macos-app-interact
skills.description: Drive a native Mac app (AppKit, SwiftUI, react-native-macos, Catalyst) with Argent. Use when targeting platform "macos" or a native macOS app, never iOS or Electron/Chromium.

skills.name: argent-metro-debugger
skills.description: Debug JS with Argent in React Native (iOS, Android, Vega, macOS) or Chromium/Electron (CDP). Use when reading console logs, inspecting React trees, evaluating JS, or checking HTTP requests.

skills.name: argent-native-profiler
skills.description: Profile native CPU hotspots, UI hangs, memory, and iOS launch time via Instruments (iOS/Mac) or Perfetto (Android). Use when diagnosing native performance issues.

skills.name: argent-qa-e2e
skills.description: Write repeatable QA regression e2e tests from test cases, tickets, or acceptance criteria (iOS, Android, Chromium, Mac apps, Vega; not Apple TV/Android TV). Use when the user asks to write, automate, or generate an e2e test or preserve a regression scenario. For one-off checks or replayable paths wi

skills.name: argent-react-native-app-workflow
skills.description: Develop and debug React Native apps on iOS simulator or Android emulator. Use when starting the app, debugging Metro, fixing builds, diagnosing runtime errors, or running tests.

skills.name: argent-react-native-optimization
skills.description: Entry-point for React Native performance optimization; profiles first via `argent-react-native-profiler`. Use when the app feels slow, fixing re-renders or jank, or improving startup/TTI.

skills.name: argent-react-native-profiler
skills.description: Profile a React Native Hermes app for JS re-renders and CPU hotspots via Argent profiler tools. Use when measuring before/after performance, diagnosing re-renders, or finding CPU hotspots.

skills.name: argent-screen-recording
skills.description: Record a screen video with Argent on iOS, Android, or Mac apps. Use when asked to capture a video clip of a flow, interaction, or animation.

skills.name: argent-screenshot-diff
skills.description: Compare saved or live app screenshots via `screenshot-diff`. Use when checking visual regressions, before/after UI diffs, layout, typography, or rendering changes.

skills.name: argent-settings-permissions
skills.description: Grant, deny, or reset app runtime permissions out-of-band on an iOS simulator or Android device via `settings-permissions`. Use when the app's own dialog or toggle cannot change the permission.

skills.name: argent-test-ui-flow
skills.description: Autonomously verify one-off mobile UI flows (iOS/Android) with interact-screenshot-verify loops. Use when testing navigation, login, manual QA steps, or visible UI changes.

skills.name: argent-tv-interact
skills.description: Control Apple TV (tvOS), Android TV (leanback), and Fire TV (Vega) via Argent (D-pad remote, focus tree, Vega JS debugging). Use when targeting runtimeKind "tv", platform "vega", or a TV app.
